title: Concept: Cheque leaf series disclosed in a response
description: A cheque book object that exposes the leaf series range in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The leaf series identifies the exact paper instruments a customer holds, and with the series an attacker can pre-empt a stop-payment instruction or forge a leaf that looks in range.
applicability: Deployments that render a cheque book object that exposes the leaf series range into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The leaf series identifies the exact paper instruments a customer holds, and with the series an attacker can pre-empt a stop-payment instruction or forge a leaf that looks in range.
